howto.name: Upload HEIC/HEIF images
howto.text: Select one or more .heic or .heif files from your iPhone or camera. Each file can be up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Choose output format and quality
howto.text: Select JPG or PNG output. For JPG, set the quality slider (1–100). Higher values preserve detail at larger file sizes.

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Click Convert. EXIF orientation is applied automatically so images display correctly. Multiple files are delivered in a ZIP.

faq.q: Why can't I open HEIC files on my computer?
faq.a: HEIC is Apple's default photo format since iOS 11. Windows and many web apps do not support it natively. Converting to JPG makes the images universally compatible.

faq.q: Is image quality lost during conversion?
faq.a: At quality 90-100, the difference is imperceptible. Lower quality settings reduce file size with minimal visible degradation.
Yes. Camera data, GPS location, and orientation are preserved by default. Use the Remove EXIF tool afterward if you want to strip metadata.
